detached_structure.evidence: A small raised deck or platform with a brown surface sits at the rear right of the central house. It may be an attached deck rather than a separate building. A small shed-like structure is also visible just behind the house to the upper left.

signals.notes: The central lot has a light gray, fairly uniform roof, a dry patchy lawn, and a paved driveway with one dark vehicle. Trees sit mostly on neighboring lots, and the rear yard looks open with a possible deck.
